test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In September 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched three ______ supercomputers, developed indigenously under the National Supercomputing Mission.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM Rudra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched three "PARAM Rudra" supercomputers with a 1-petaflop processing capability, developed indigenously by C-DAC, Pune, under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM).
 
• The supercomputers are deployed in Pune, Delhi, and Kolkata to facilitate pioneering scientific research in various fields.
 
• The "Giant Metre Radio Telescope" in Pune will leverage the supercomputer to explore Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) and other astronomical phenomena.
 
• NSM was launched in 2015 and is jointly steered by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other Supercomputers Under NSM__

 
 
• The first supercomputer under NSM, "PARAM Shivay," was installed at IIT BHU in 2019, followed by other supercomputers like "PARAM Shakti" and "PARAM Brahma."
